title: 第13章 师父离开的第一天
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
今天是师父离开破庙的第一天。

    厉行天缓缓睁开了眼，从几块木头拼接出来的简易小木床上爬了起来。

    大厅位置已经被师傅和师姐占的差不多了，加上一个熟饭和炼丹通用的大铁锅。

    已经没有足够的空位再留床，所以厉天行睡的是神像后的空间。

    不过师姐已经打算在破庙外初步建一个小木屋。

    毕竟师姐是唯一的女性，男女有别自然也是正常。

    这件事已经得到了师父的首肯，师姐早在几天之前就开始建，而且进度还是蛮快。

    因为届时自己也不用继续躺在神像后的内屋去睡。

    之所以嫌弃那边的原因便是有个破洞，夜间经常有蚊子侵袭，还有不知名的虫子也会上来咬上一口。

    此刻厉行天还未筑基，不能有灵气护体，蚊子的侵袭简直烦不胜烦。

    所以师姐搭建小屋，厉行天还是非常赞同的，甚至还帮了师姐不少忙。

    估计再有两三天一个小屋子就造好了。

    昨天的鸡……师姐看了鸡的惨烈的尸骸之后也是一口没吃。

    不过师姐却要求自己吃完。

    这个要求厉行天也自然能理解，毕竟师姐抓的鸡，自己煮成那样，也该归自己吃完。

    原本厉行天以为哪一只鸡死状惨烈，会无比难吃。

    结果入嘴感觉味道也是尚可。

    不知道是经历过师父粗狂无比的疗伤灵药的原因。

    厉行天只觉得这一只鸡腥了一点，寡淡无味了一点，肉柴了一点。

    其余味道还是非常不错的，起码是属于人能吃的范畴。

    不过师姐的评价就不是那么好，师姐称这锅鸡为——死鸡洗澡水。

    但师姐已经筑基，能够辟谷，厉行天也不用担心师姐饿肚子。

    毕竟已经答应了师父尽量照顾好师姐，厉行天并非是那种爽约的人。

    虽然……师弟照顾师姐听起来有点怪怪的。

    破庙门外，几道猛烈灵气的波动传来。

    厉行天迈步走出破庙，目光看向不远处的李应灵。

    此刻她正手持木剑，不断操控神通的力度轰击一棵大树，力道刚好，树木顺着剑气流动果断倒下。

    不得不说，师姐的上进心还是非常足的，建房子伐木时也在修炼神通。

    而且看上去进步斐然……

    不得不说师姐天资即使在中州也能称得上天才，初次见面时明显能感觉到她的神通还未掌握。

    这才多久，已经运用随心。
content_en:
Today is the first day that Master leaves the ruined temple.

    Li Xingtian slowly opened his eyes and climbed up from the simple wooden bed made of several pieces of wood.

    The space in the hall has been almost occupied by the master and senior sister, plus a large iron pot used for cooking rice and making alchemy.

    There was not enough room for any more beds, so Li Tianxing slept in the space behind the statue.

    However, the senior sister has already planned to build a small wooden house outside the ruined temple.

    After all, the senior sister is the only female, so it is normal for men and women to be different.

    This matter has been approved by the master. The senior sister started the construction a few days ago, and the progress is quite fast.

    Because then he would not have to continue sleeping in the inner room behind the statue.

    The reason why I dislike that place is that there is a hole. Mosquitoes often attack at night, and unknown insects will come up and take a bite.

    At this moment, Li Xingtian has not yet built the foundation, so he cannot have spiritual energy to protect his body. The mosquito infestation is simply annoying.

    Therefore, Li Xingtian strongly agreed with the senior sister's construction of the hut, and even helped the senior sister a lot.

    It is estimated that a small house will be built in two or three days.

    Yesterday's chicken... the senior sister didn't eat a bite after looking at the tragic carcass of the chicken.

    However, the senior sister asked to finish the meal by herself.

    Li Xingtian can naturally understand this request. After all, if the chicken caught by the senior sister is cooked like this, it should be eaten by herself.

    Li Xingtian originally thought that one of the chickens died tragically and would be extremely unpalatable.

    As a result, the taste in my mouth is acceptable.

    I don’t know why it was because I had experienced the master’s extremely rough healing elixir.

    Li Xingtian only felt that this one was a little fishy, ​​a little bland, and a little meaty.

    The rest of the taste is still very good, at least it is within the category that humans can eat.

    However, the senior sister's evaluation was not so good. The senior sister called this pot of chicken - dead chicken bath water.

    But the senior sister has already established a foundation and can live without food, so Li Xingtian doesn't have to worry about the senior sister being hungry.

    After all, he had promised his master to take good care of his senior sister as much as possible, and Li Xingtian was not the kind of person who broke the promise.

    Although... it sounds a bit weird for a junior brother to take care of his senior sister.

    Outside the gate of the ruined temple, several violent fluctuations of spiritual energy came.

    Li Xingtian stepped out of the ruined temple and looked at Li Yingling not far away.

    At this moment, she was holding a wooden sword, constantly controlling the strength of her magical power to bombard a big tree. The force was just right, and the tree fell decisively along with the flow of sword energy.

    I have to say that the senior sister is very motivated and is practicing magical powers while building a house and cutting wood.

    And it seems to be making great progress...

    I have to say that senior sister's talent can be called a genius even in Zhongzhou. When we first met, it was obvious that she had not yet mastered her magical powers.

    How long has it been since I started using Xixin?
title_en: Chapter 13 The first day the master left
